title: Meet Hydrogen
summary: Discover what hydrogen is and why it rarely travels alone on Earth.
facts: Most abundant element in the universe
Yet we almost never find it by itself on Earth
remember: On Earth it is usually attached to something else.

wordToRemember.definition: An element is a basic substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by ordinary chemical means.
